items.title: George Guesnon Interview, 1965-09
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Him and Earl Foucher. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. He married a girl and everything out of Mobile. But now he's living in San Diego California. Yeah. He's still there. Oh yeah. Well I don't know about him. He's still there.

ctx.x: Sure. And you heard these old recordings he made with Celestine and he plays some tremendous breaks or saxophone. Oh he was the greatest.

Yeah. He was him and Alto. Him and Earl Foucher. He was the two greatest in New Orleans at that time. Earl Foucher. Yeah. Earl Foucher of the Sam Martin. He came from New York didn't he? No he come from Mobile Alabama. That's his own Mobile.
Yeah. He married a girl and everything out of Mobile. But now he's living in San Diego California. Yeah. He's still there. Oh yeah. Well I don't know about him. He's still there.
